stations.title: Idris
stations.say: A price or why not, every time.
stations.note: After two bad nights in a row.

stations.title: Poster quote
stations.text: 60 sheets, 100 asked for: the step throws.

stations.title: Your docket
stations.gap: A throw ends the whole script

captions: Idris wants every quote in the price list to end with a price or a reason.
Today a quote that throws takes the whole script down with it.
You turn throws into failed dockets and send them to one catch(), in three tasks.
Now the poster quote says why there is no price, and the others carry on.
One catch() at the end of each chain, and the price list never crashes.
